info.name: Western Union Mass Payments Balances API

params.name: clientId
params.description: The partner's Western Union client ID.

params.name: currencyCode
params.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

items.docs: Returns the current holding balance for the specified currency in the partner's WU account. Used to verify sufficient funds before initiating payments.
